title: Catalysts
coreMove: Look for a pathway changer that accelerates the reaction without becoming the fuel.
sourcePressure: Catalysts speed reactions without being consumed and can shift the path of progress instead of adding raw force.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: calling any helpful person a catalyst without showing the pathway change

hook: opening with a definition of Catalysts
counterintuition: calling any helpful person a catalyst without showing the pathway change
tryThisNow: set a timer and think about it
audit your life with no chapter-specific object
examples: same dashboard meeting with swapped names
kitchen-table family argument unless the domain requires it
teacher and student scene used as default proof

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
